author: yunyun
description: Wynncraft API v3 utility cog for Red-DiscordBot. Provides commands for fetching player and guild information, leaderboards, and more.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Wynncraft cog. Use `[p]load wynncraft`, then `[p]wynn`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores optional Wynncraft API token globally and per-guild online watch settings. It does not store Wynncraft player secrets.
